notes: re-scoped from the shared unit to sysml alone (ADR-0015)
decision: A transcription of SysML 8.2.2.14.2. The clause and the Xtext state this production identically — `ownedRelatedElement += InterfaceEnd` in both — so there is nothing to weigh. It contributes no tokens of its own; the text of an end is entirely in InterfaceEnd, and the 'to' of the binary form and the brackets and commas of the n-ary form belong to BinaryInterfacePart and NaryInterfacePart respectively. That is what lets one member production serve both.

evidence.note: States the production; the rule is its transcription.
Line 162 `interface differential.rightDiffPort to rearAxle.rightHalfAxle.axleToDiffPort;` has one of these members on each side of 'to', each holding an InterfaceEnd that is a feature chain.
Lines 77-83 hold six of these members inside one n-ary interface part, comma-separated; each takes InterfaceEnd's `( declaredName = NAME REFERENCES )?` form, naming the end before `::>`.
Second opinion. Identical to the clause.
